amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The refund amount. Must be the verified line total from Check Return Window.

orderId.title: Order Id
orderId.description: The Salesforce record Id of the order.

orderItemId.title: Order Item Id
orderItemId.description: The Salesforce record Id of the specific line item being refunded. Leave blank only for a whole-order refund.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The return reason. Must be one of the restricted picklist values: Damaged, Wrong item, Not as described, Changed mind.
